skills.name: 천뢰 관통포
skills.action: A single majestic focused celestial lightning spear descends vertically from high above and pierces an invisible fortress impact point. Use a narrow gold-white lance, cyan lightning filaments, a small elaborate golden magic reticle, a sharp directional impact crown and heavy bright blue crystal sparks. It must read as a piercing precision strike, not a fireball or broad screen flash.
skills.stages: Frames 1-4: small suspended golden targeting sigil develops, branching cyan charge collects high above. Frames 5-6: the thin long spear forms and descends toward the ground. Frame 7: the spear first touches the ground anchor. Frames 8-10: a sharp impact crown flares out with splitting lightning and discrete crystal shards. Frames 11-13: the spear breaks into descending filaments, impact crown collapses. Frames 14-16: only distinct fading tiny electric fragments remain, nearly gone in the final frame.
skills.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an actual ANIMATED VFX SPRITE ATLAS for a premium Korean fantasy game's territorial battle, skill "천뢰 관통포". Generate ONE transparent PNG containing EXACTLY 16 individually hand-painted animation frames in an exact 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS grid, row-major chronological order. Native square 2048x2048 preferred, each cell equally sized. There must be NO drawn grid, NO frame borders, NO numbers, NO captions, NO letters, NO background. TRUE transparent alpha outside the effects, never a black background, checkerboard or opaque gray fill.

Subject: A single majestic focused celestial lightning spear descends vertically from high above and pierces an invisible fortress impact point. Use a narrow gold-white lance, cyan lightning filaments, a small elaborate golden magic reticle, a sharp directional impact crown and heavy bright blue crystal sparks. It must read as a piercing precision strike, not a fireball or broad screen flash.
Animation choreography: Frames 1-4: small suspended golden targeting sigil develops, branching cyan charge collects high above. Frames 5-6: the thin long spear forms and descends toward the ground. Frames 11-13: the spear breaks into descending filaments, impact crown collapses. Frames 14-16: only distinct fading tiny electric fragments remain, nearly gone in the final frame.

Every frame must be a genuinely DIFFERENT consecutive phase of the same effect: transforming lines, branching energy, moving shards, changing shape and dispersal. Do not repeat a still image at different scales. Hold the camera and anchor fixed in every cell. Coordinate system for every cell: visual center at x50%; ground/impact anchor x50%, y76%; glow and fragments stay within x10..90% and y8..89% with EMPTY transparent gutters. Fixed camera front 3/4 slight downward game battle view. Give the whole effect enough room, no clipping against cell edges. The descending spear's maximum height, if any, stays within the same cell.

Style: luxurious hand-painted semi-realistic RPG spell VFX, sharply defined high-density colored energy, ivory gold and electric cyan, fine material details and beautifully drawn glyph-like ornament without any readable text. Rich saturated solid color in the core and elegant alpha falloff only at outer edges. No milky fog, no white full-frame flash, no screen blur, no huge blank glowing blob. No cartoon star symbols. No scenery, no figures, no weapons held by characters, no UI. Deliver clean production-ready evenly aligned 4x4 animation sheet, all 16 cells fully visible.

skills.name: 동력 교란파
skills.color: royal violet, magenta and cool electric blue
skills.action: A premium fantasy anti-energy pulse disrupts a suspended mechanical crystal power core. Thin violet segmented rings wind around the small blue crystal core, then snap into angular electric shock arcs and a low expanding ring. Show the core's energy being torn outward into violet shards and dissipating. A compact target-centered disruption effect with no environment or structure; radically distinct from the vertical lance.
skills.stages: Frames 1-4: small blue energy core and two thin segmented purple rotating charge arcs appear and thicken. Frames 5-7: the core contracts and sharp violet lightning cages it. Frame 8: a clear outward electromagnetic ring ruptures at the core, its energy breaks into many fragments. Frames 9-12: widening broken purple ring and outward-moving shards, blue central light visibly drains away. Frames 13-16: sparse drifting fragments and broken arc residue dissolve; final frame nearly empty.

skills.name: 성채 재건
skills.color: luminous emerald teal and refined champagne gold
skills.action: A beautiful restorative fortress ward builds from flowing emerald life energy and floating small gold-and-ivory stone fragments. A graceful translucent but richly colored emerald shield-shaped sigil forms above a low golden circular rune; tiny stone pieces assemble into a compact magical parapet at its base and then resolve into ascending healing motes. A powerful architectural reconstruction effect, no complete castle or character, entirely different morphology from the two offensive pulses.
skills.stages: Frames 1-4: emerald motes rise from a thin golden ground circle; a few ivory-gold stone fragments float upward. Frames 5-7: fragments assemble and green shield rune is drawn continuously upward. Frame 8: the full elegant gold-edged emerald ward locks into place over the ground circle. Frames 9-12: three green restoration waves cascade downward and rising sparks recharge the shield. Frames 13-16: the ward gently opens into ribbons and the stones dissolve into upward motes, last frame nearly gone.
